audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was scored for Trundle while every line of prose says Keeper's Verdict denies that exact window; 2+ items was scored for Poppy while the prose says the 1v1 flips to Trundle there.
audit.why: Trundle is at 46.15% over 143 games, so Poppy should own the middle of the lane — but the two stages that were wrong were wrong in opposite directions, and each one contradicted its own why-text.
audit.corrected: Level 6 moved to Poppy (her R is up at the same level as yours and it cancels your window); 2+ items moved to Trundle (Subjugate finally out-scales her stacked resists). Chart now reads Trundle/Skill/Poppy/Poppy/Poppy/Poppy/Trundle.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere on the spike markers — 'Lvl 3', 'Lvl 6' with no idea how long the punish window lasts.
audit.why: Heroic Charge is 14s at rank 1 and Keeper's Verdict is 140s at rank 1. A 140-second ultimate is the single largest window in the lane and it was never quantified.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns added to the level-2, level-3 and level-6 spikes and to breakdown.cooldowns, with 'fight the whole cooldown' after the R is baited.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three separate fabrications: (a) 'Q knockup' — Hammer Shock slows and detonates a zone, the knock-up is Keeper's Verdict; (b) 'her W blocks your Pillar' and 'Use W to block any Pillar you throw' — Steadfast Presence stops dashes, and Pillar of Ice is terrain creation, not a dash; (c) 'Chomp's AS steal' — Chomp saps Attack Damage.
audit.why: Each one sends the player into the wrong decision: waiting for a knock-up that never comes, holding Pillar because they think it gets eaten, and itemising against the wrong stat.
audit.corrected: Hammer Shock described as a slow zone, Steadfast Presence described as a dash-stop plus scaling resists, and the sap named as attack damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction of the matchup was absent: Pillar of Ice is impassable terrain, and Heroic Charge stuns any target pushed into a wall.
audit.why: Riot's own text gives both halves — Pillar 'becoming impassable terrain', Heroic Charge 'If the target is pushed into a wall, it is stunned'. A Trundle who drops Pillar behind himself hands Poppy a free stun she otherwise has to walk you into.
audit.corrected: Stated in early, whys[1], phases[2].why, wants.you[0] and breakdown.cooldowns: drop Pillar behind her, never behind yourself.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing connected Steadfast Presence's health-scaled resists to Subjugate's steal.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence's armour and MR bonus 'increases when she is low on Health', and Subjugate steals a percent of the target's Armor and Magic Resistance at the moment of cast — so the same ultimate is worth more the deeper into the trade it lands.
audit.corrected: Written into mid as an explicit sequencing rule: trade her down first, then cash Subjugate.

edits.before: Poppy's full kit comes online — her E wall-stun into Q knockup is a kill setup you cannot trade through without burning Flash.
edits.after: Heroic Charge (14s at rank 1) into Hammer Shock is her kill setup — the stun only lands if a wall is behind you, so fight in open lane.

edits.before: Poppy's Keeper's Verdict punts you out of your own Frozen Domain mid-fight, hard-countering your W empowerment window.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict (140s) punts you out of Frozen Domain mid-fight — she holds it for the second you commit, so bait it first.

edits.before: Land Pillar of Ice behind Poppy to block her E dash and deny her wall-stun setup
edits.after: Keep Pillar of Ice off your own back line — Heroic Charge stuns you into any wall

edits.before: Bait Keeper's Verdict before dropping Frozen Domain and all-inning at Level 6
edits.after: Bait Keeper's Verdict (140s at rank 1), then drop Frozen Domain and all-in

edits.before: E-dash you into a wall for the stun, then Q knockup into full trade
edits.after: Heroic Charge you into a wall for the stun, then Hammer Shock zone on top

edits.before: Use W to block any Pillar you throw to cut off her escape or setup
edits.after: Bait out Pillar of Ice, then charge you into it for the stun

edits.before: Poppy's E dash into a wall stun lands at level 2 and she will immediately hunt a wall angle — Pillar placement is your only answer and she can W it; she owns this window.
edits.after: Heroic Charge lands at level 2 and she will hunt a wall angle at once — and your own Pillar of Ice is a wall she can charge you into, so place it behind her.

edits.before: Full Q-W-E rotation online for Poppy before Subjugate comes online for you — wall-stun into Q knockup decides every extended trade here.
edits.after: Her full rotation lands before Subjugate does: Heroic Charge into a wall stuns you, then Hammer Shock's zone holds you there for the follow-up.

edits.before: Chomp's AS steal chips away but her W blocks your Pillar escapes and her zone control neutralizes Frozen Domain — neither side has a clean opener.
edits.after: Chomp saps her AD, but Steadfast Presence (20s) hands her armour and MR that climb as her health drops, so her zoning cancels out Frozen Domain.

edits.before: Keeper's Verdict punts you off your Frozen Domain and resets the fight before Subjugate can resolve — bait the ult or refuse the all-in.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict (140s at rank 1) punts you off Frozen Domain and resets the fight before Subjugate's 4-second doubling ever pays out.

edits.before: Neither of you has a hard level-1 punish button, so the first couple of waves are a coin flip of auto-trade reads — Chomp the moment she steps to last-hit and bank the AS steal, but do not over-commit chasing because she has no real escape yet and will turn on you. The danger starts at level 2: Poppy's E dash into a wall is not a mobility tool, it is a stun delivery system, and the moment she has it she will hunt a wall angle on you. Keep at least one step of distance from any terrain at all times, because her E into the wall into Q knockup is a full punish combo that wins the trade decisively even at these early levels. Level 3 she has the full rotation and you do not yet have the Subjugate payoff to absorb it — respect the wall geometry and farm safely rather than trading even.
edits.after: Neither of you has a hard level-1 punish button, so the first waves are a coin flip of auto-trade reads — Chomp on her last-hit step and bank the AD sap, but do not over-commit chasing, because she has no escape yet and will turn on you. The danger starts at level 2: Heroic Charge (14s at rank 1) is not a mobility tool, it is a stun delivery system, and the moment she has it she will hunt a wall angle on you. Keep a step of distance from terrain at all times, because the charge into a wall followed by Hammer Shock's slow zone wins the trade decisively even at these levels. Worse, your own Pillar of Ice is impassable terrain and counts as that wall, so never drop it behind yourself. Level 3 she has the full rotation and you have no Subjugate payoff yet — respect the geometry and farm rather than trade even.

edits.before: Levels 4 and 5 are her window to grind small advantages through disciplined poke and zone control; she will use Q to contest your Frozen Domain placement and W to cancel any gap-close attempt, so extended trades in this range are not in your favor yet. At level 6 the math should shift — Subjugate drains her armor and MR directly onto you mid-fight, which is real value against a tank-oriented kit — but Keeper's Verdict completely neutralizes this window if she punts you out of your Frozen Domain before the drain resolves. Bait the R first: feign an all-in, absorb or dodge the punt, then drop W and Subjugate immediately after; fighting through the ult cooldown is the only version of level 6 you reliably win. If you cannot bait the R, do not all-in — farm and wait for the cooldown.
edits.after: Levels 4 and 5 are her window: Hammer Shock (8s at rank 1) contests every Frozen Domain you place, and Steadfast Presence hands her armour and MR that climb the lower her health goes, so extended trades here are not yours yet. At level 6 the math should shift, and that health-scaled resist bonus is exactly why — Subjugate steals a percent of the armour and MR she has at the instant you cast, so the same ultimate is worth more the deeper into the trade it lands. Trade her down first, then cash it. Keeper's Verdict (140s at rank 1) is what breaks the window: she punts you off your own domain before the 4-second doubling resolves. Bait it — feign the all-in, eat the punt, then drop W and Subjugate and fight that whole cooldown.

edits.before: - Poppy Heroic Charge: matchup-defining — Wall-pin stun. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Poppy Steadfast Presence: Resists + STOPS enemy dashes nearby; grounds them. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Heroic Charge (E): 14/13/12/11/10s. It only stuns if a wall is behind you — and your own Pillar of Ice counts as one. - Keeper's Verdict (R): 140/120/100s. Bait it, then fight the entire cooldown.

edits.before: W down at your feet turns short trades your way: move speed, attack speed, and healing on your own terrain. Trade only inside the zone.
edits.after: Frozen Domain at your feet wins the short trades, but if she took Heroic Charge at 2 the wall angle decides it — trade away from terrain.

edits.before: Pillar closes the kit — use it behind Poppy to deny disengage, or between you and Heroic Charge to break her pattern.
edits.after: Pillar of Ice is also a wall — drop it behind Poppy, never behind yourself, or Heroic Charge stuns you into it.

edits.before: Q ranks raise the bite damage and the AD steal. Keep trading in W; if Poppy stands in your domain trading evenly, she is losing.
edits.after: Hammer Shock is down to 6s at rank 3 and contests every Frozen Domain you place. Trade only in the beat after she has spent it.

edits.before: Subjugate online — the 1v1 is yours into almost anyone the moment Poppy commits. R early in the all-in so the drained resists count for the whole fight.
edits.after: Keeper's Verdict (140s) arrives on the same level as Subjugate and punts you off Frozen Domain before the 4-second doubling pays. Bait it first.

edits.before: Trinity Force is the duel spike — Spellblade procs off every Chomp. Force Poppy to answer you in the side lane.
edits.after: Her Iceborn Gauntlet holds you inside Hammer Shock's zone each cycle. Farm, and wait for your second item to flip it.

notes: Poppy's Hammer Shock carries a derived 'grounding' flag in the kit file that Riot's own description does not support (the text says only slow plus a delayed zone detonation). I trusted the description and wrote no grounding claim for Q. Unverified and therefore left alone: whether Keeper's Verdict's channel can be interrupted, and whether Poppy can use a freshly-spawned Pillar of Ice as the stun wall in the same instant it appears (the geometry timing is not in Riot's text). Also left as found: content spikes[2] asserts Poppy builds Iceborn Gauntlet, which is a build claim I cannot verify from kit data.
